initialSource.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE landscape 16:9 museum-quality naturalistic paleoart cover for Fauna Atlas. The ONLY animal in the whole image is a single Liopleurodon ferox, short-necked Jurassic pliosaur, massive elongated broad skull, robust barrel-shaped torso, four large long hydrofoil flippers arranged as two pairs, short tapering tail. Smooth speculative charcoal-gray skin with pale underside, tooth rows but mouth closed. NO dorsal fin, NO tail flukes, NO legs, NO horns. Environment: Middle Jurassic European sea, fully underwater in clear blue-green water with subtle distant seabed. Exact side view showing COMPLETE animal, every flipper or foot and BOTH ends of neck and tail. Animal entirely within x=44% to96% canvas width, center x=70%, y=50%. The left40% must contain ONLY quiet open water/seabed, with no animal. Maximize complete animal inside that right-side region, 5% background margins around all extremities. No text, watermark, frame, labels, human, skeleton or additional creatures. This is scientific reconstruction with speculative muted coloration.
